operations.notes: First-ever generate path: drop+recreate cognitive_test, enable extensions (incl. AGE), apply 12 migration files, pg_dump --format=custom --no-sync --no-comments via docker exec. No threshold in §5.1 for cold-start of empty snapshot — this is the baseline we'll measure regressions against.
sha256 hash of the 106KB dump file. Comfortably under the §5.1 target of <100ms.
Hash check on a single file. §5.1 has no explicit verify threshold; treated as cache-hit-equivalent.

Drop+recreate target DB, preload extensions, pg_restore --clean --if-exists --no-owner --no-privileges, count entities/facts. Above the <1s target but well under the 3s hard cap. The cold-restart path on Windows + Docker pays a non-trivial container exec startup cost. Optimisation deferred to j77.4 if a Phase 1 benchmark consumer needs it.

Second-run generate (warm container, warm migrations). The §5.1 generate thresholds (<5min target) are aimed at the Frankenstein-10chunks LLM ingest path; the empty baseline is too small to share a threshold band.

disk_size.notes: Schema-only dump of 12 migrations. §5.1 disk-size threshold (<50MB target / <200MB hard cap) is for synthetic-10k; empty is well below.
